name: MITES Saturdays
org: MIT (MITES, Introduction to Technology, Engineering and Science)
what_you_do: You take Saturday STEM classes at MIT during the school year. Topics range from robotics to bioengineering. It is a multi-year program with college application guidance. Lunch is free.
who_can_apply: Public school students from Boston, Cambridge or Lawrence, MA in 7th, 8th, 9th or 10th grade who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents (green card). Exceptions are not made.
pay_detail: Free of charge. Students pay only their own transportation to MIT (Lawrence students get free transport).
duration: 8 Saturdays in spring and 8 in fall, 10:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., for up to about five and a half years
deadline_text: The application deadline is not stated on the program pages read. Check the Apply page.
how_to_apply: Create a profile in the MITES application portal and submit the MITES Saturdays application (separate from the Summer and Semester application).
notes: Students are expected to keep A and B grades; no minimum GPA to apply. The program encourages applicants who are underrepresented in STEM or from lower-income families or the first in their family to attend college.
